name: Bloodsurge turns into Bloodchaser on expiry and on Accursed Form (#1201)
contract: Bloodsurge 553267 has three effects. Effect 0 (aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, MiscValue 32 = Shadow, BasePoints 29) and effect 2 (aura 216 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CASTING_SPEED_NOT_STACK, MiscValue 126, BasePoints 29) are native and already work. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Bloodchaser 523721, and Spell.dbc gives 553267 ProcFlags 0. The tooltip's condition - 'At the end of the duration, or whenever you trigger Accursed Form, gain Bloodchaser instead' - cannot be a spell_proc row at all: an aura reaching the end of its duration is not a proc event and an Accursed Form application is not a damage or cast event, so the clause is implemented in AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp. Bloodsurge lasts 20 s (DurationIndex 18) and Bloodchaser 30 s (DurationIndex 9). The buff is fixtured with set_aura rather than cast because 553267 has a 180 s cooldown and ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 802877; the fixture uses Player::AddAura with the player as caster, so the expiry reports the ordinary AURA_REMOVE_BY_EXPIRE the script requires. The regression control reads cast_speed_multiplier rather than spell_modifier because effect 0 is aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, which is not a SpellModOp and therefore invisible to that metric, while effect 2's aura 216 feeds the native cast-speed multiplier directly. Note that the installed Spell.dbc says 'spell haste' for $s3 and effect 2 is aura 216, while the bindmysoul snapshot renders 'spell critical strike chance'; the installed DBC is authority here and neither is changed.

steps.label: Trigger Accursed Form while Bloodsurge is running
DISCRIMINATING: Accursed Form converts Bloodsurge into Bloodchaser
and Bloodsurge is gone, because the tooltip says 'instead'
Clear it again for the expiry half
The native spell-haste half (effect 2, aura 216) is in effect
Let the 20 s buff run out on its own
